logp.method_description: The log P values copper(II) complexes and ligands were determined according to the shake-flask method [23]. Weighted amounts of the analyzed compounds were partitioned between equal volumes of water and 1-octanol by shaking for 3 h at room temperature. Due to low solubility of copper(II) complexes, the shaking time was elongated to 24 h to assure full partitioning of the analyzed compounds between two water and 1-octanol phases. Then, the solution was centrifuged at 3500g (15 min) for separate into two layers. The concentration of Cu(II) complexes and ligands in the aqueous phase were measured by UV/VIS spectrometry. Additionally for ligands, both phases were analyzed by HPLC method in isocratic elution (80% methanol in water). Each sample (separated phase) was injected into C18 reversed-phase column and the peak area was determined. On the basis of these results, the partition coefficients were calculated.
